progression.narrative: The performance opens on Fs4 and dwells most on A in Rak. Nowruz-e Arab (0:37.3) introduces Cs, Db, D, centred on A. Zarbi (3:04.4) introduces B, centred on A. The line peaks at Fs4 (366.9 Hz) at 0:00.9. It closes on D4, not the tonic (E4 → E4 → E4 → Db4 → A3 → D4).
